variants.title: 좌우로 열리는 셔터
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D anime mechanical rhythm-game button concept sheet for not4k. The accepted idea is ONLY that pressing an input button opens a thruster and light exhaust emerges. Everything about appearance in this sheet is a proposal. Input image is a conceptual and mood reference only; do not copy its exact silhouette, frame, keycap, shutter, material layout or embellishments. Design just ONE coherent playable button module shown in THREE same-scale identical-camera states left-to-right: IDLE, SINGLE, DOUBLE. Landscape sheet, nearly black background, three evenly spaced large modules, subtle small uppercase labels IDLE / SINGLE / DOUBLE below. Each state must be mechanically the SAME module: same width, outer socket silhouette, camera and keycap; only key travel, shutter and exhaust change. Perspective: clear front three-quarter slightly elevated view showing the pressable top and lower thruster opening. Dark midnight blue and graphite metal, restrained silver bevel edges, crisp 2D cel-shaded anime mechanical concept art with controlled luminous highlights, matching the reference's subdued flight theme; no photoreal 3D product render. The flat broad pressable top must stay visibly a separate keycap, not a decorative reactor button. In IDLE thruster is closed and unlit. In SINGLE blue-white exhaust is visible outside the opening. In DOUBLE amber-gold emission is clearly distinguishable by its two luminous streams as an exploratory visual. Exhaust exits beneath the keycap and extends beyond the lower metal edge into open space, with restrained soft falloff and a bright short core, not just an illuminated jewel inside a housing. The light must never obscure the top input surface. Keep dark space around each item, no frame, no keyboard, no hands, no game screenshot, no logos, no screws wallpaper, no random emblems, no explanatory text other than labels. Show the mechanism credibly without adding arrows or exploded parts. Design A: a compact low-profile wedge key atop a deep rectangular thruster socket. Two solid shutter halves slide horizontally LEFT and RIGHT, revealing a wide central slot below the keycap. Idle shows a clean center seam. Single opens just enough for a broad blue-white luminous slit with one coherent exhaust band. Double opens wider for two separated gold exhaust columns within the same unchanged socket. The enclosure has just a few large folded armor planes and purposeful gaps. No round nozzles.
